meta.description: Safety evaluation set for the emergency/crisis guardrail. Mixes crisis messages the keyword rules would MISS (indirect phrasing) with keyword-obvious ones and benign controls, to quantify what the LLM guardrail adds and to check it doesn't over-trigger on normal sexual-health questions.

fields.expected_emergency: should this escalate to real-world help?
fields.hard: true if the phrasing has no obvious emergency keyword (the guardrail's job)
